name: Independent exploration and evidence review
objective: Investigate the human's question independently, compare evidence, and produce a verifiable artifact.
constraints: Each participant uses its own context and publishes findings. No fixed roles. Declare roundtable_stage_ready when your current stage is finished. Human approval is required to advance. Claims are not validation.

stages.name: Independent exploration
stages.objective: Reason from the human brief and explicitly attached inputs. Publish your own findings as an artifact, then declare stage readiness. Peer and filesystem tools are withheld during this stage.

stages.name: Compare and verify
stages.objective: Read the independent findings, record agreements and disagreements on the evidence board, verify a peer's JSON artifact if appropriate, and publish your revised conclusion.
